description: Record one competitor price observation by hand, for the pipeline to match against your catalog: a competitor's observed price for a product. The cycle usually collects these itself. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

currency.description: The currency code, such as USD.

external_id.description: The competitor's own id for the product.

gtin.description: The product GTIN, used to match it to a catalog item.

observed_at.description: When it was seen. Defaults to now.

raw.description: The source record, kept with the observation.

source.description: Where the price came from, such as manual or the name of your scraper.

source_confidence.description: How far to trust the source, 0 to 1.

title.description: The product title as the competitor shows it.

name: add_commerce_observation
